types.description: Use this clause for standard net-30 payment terms applicable to all domestic vendor transactions. Governs invoicing schedules, dispute resolution timelines, and early-payment discount provisions under applicable law. Applies where no preferred or fallback variant has been negotiated.
types.clauseLanguage: Payment shall be due within NET_DAYS days of the invoice date. PARTY_A shall remit funds to PARTY_B by electronic transfer to the account designated in writing. Invoices unpaid after NET_DAYS days shall be subject to a late fee as specified in the Late Payment clause. This clause is governed by the laws of GOVERNING_LAW and is effective as of EFFECTIVE_DATE.

types.description: Preferred terms for strategic EU vendors. Allows net-45 with early-payment incentive.
types.clauseLanguage: Der Rechnungsbetrag ist innerhalb von NET_DAYS Tagen nach Rechnungsdatum durch PARTY_A auf das von PARTY_B schriftlich benannte Konto zu überweisen. Bei vorzeitiger Zahlung innerhalb von EARLY_PAYMENT_DAYS Tagen gewährt PARTY_B einen Skonto von DISCOUNT_RATE%. Diese Klausel unterliegt dem Recht von GOVERNING_LAW und tritt am EFFECTIVE_DATE in Kraft.

types.description: Fallback clause for APAC region when standard terms cannot be applied. Subject to local regulatory review before execution.
types.clauseLanguage: Unless otherwise agreed in writing, PARTY_A shall pay all invoices submitted by PARTY_B within NET_DAYS calendar days of receipt. Payments shall be made in CURRENCY to the bank account specified by PARTY_B. This clause is effective from EFFECTIVE_DATE and governed by GOVERNING_LAW. Local regulatory requirements may apply and shall take precedence where mandated.

types.description: Defines penalty interest rates applied to overdue invoices. Use when a supplier has exceeded the agreed payment window and a late fee must be formally assessed per the master agreement.
types.clauseLanguage: Any amount not paid by PARTY_A by the due date shall accrue interest at a rate of INTEREST_RATE% per annum, calculated daily from the date payment was due until the date of actual payment. PARTY_B reserves the right to suspend services after GRACE_PERIOD days of non-payment, provided written notice has been issued. This clause is effective as of EFFECTIVE_DATE under the laws of GOVERNING_LAW.

types.description: EU preferred terms with reduced penalty rates for long-term strategic partners.
types.clauseLanguage: Verzugszinsen werden ab dem Fälligkeitsdatum in Höhe von INTEREST_RATE% p.a. auf den ausstehenden Betrag berechnet. PARTY_B behält sich vor, Leistungen nach GRACE_PERIOD Tagen Zahlungsverzug durch PARTY_A vorübergehend einzustellen, sofern eine schriftliche Mahnung ergangen ist. Für strategische Partner gilt ein reduzierter Zinssatz gemäß gesonderter Vereinbarung. Maßgebliches Recht: GOVERNING_LAW. Wirksam ab EFFECTIVE_DATE.

types.description: Standard global pricing clause covering list price, discount tiers, and currency adjustment mechanisms. Use for all supplier agreements where price stability over the contract term must be contractually guaranteed.
types.clauseLanguage: The prices set forth in Schedule A shall remain fixed for the duration of the CONTRACT_TERM period commencing EFFECTIVE_DATE. PARTY_B may revise list prices upon NOTICE_PERIOD days' prior written notice to PARTY_A, subject to a maximum annual increase of PRICE_CAP_PCT%. All prices are exclusive of applicable taxes, duties, and levies unless otherwise expressly stated. This clause is governed by GOVERNING_LAW.

types.description: Caps liability at the total value of fees paid in the prior 12 months. Apply when negotiating with vendors whose services carry operational risk. Not for use in agreements involving personal data processing or critical infrastructure.
types.clauseLanguage: In no event shall either party be liable to the other for any indirect, incidental, special, punitive, or consequential damages, including loss of profits or data, arising out of or related to this Agreement. The aggregate liability of PARTY_B to PARTY_A under this Agreement shall not exceed LIABILITY_CAP, being the total fees paid in the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim. This limitation applies regardless of the form of action and shall survive termination of this Agreement. Effective as of EFFECTIVE_DATE under GOVERNING_LAW.

types.description: EU-compliant preferred terms with higher liability cap for strategic partners.
types.clauseLanguage: Die Haftung von PARTY_B gegenüber PARTY_A ist auf LIABILITY_CAP begrenzt, entsprechend den in den vorangegangenen zwölf Monaten gezahlten Vergütungen. Eine Haftung für mittelbare Schäden, entgangenen Gewinn oder Datenverlust ist ausgeschlossen, soweit gesetzlich zulässig. Für strategische Partner gilt eine erhöhte Haftungsgrenze gemäß gesonderter Anlage. Diese Klausel unterliegt dem Recht von GOVERNING_LAW und gilt ab EFFECTIVE_DATE.

types.description: Fallback liability cap for situations where standard terms are rejected in negotiation.
types.clauseLanguage: Notwithstanding any other provision of this Agreement, neither party shall be liable for any punitive or exemplary damages. The total liability of either party shall be capped at LIABILITY_CAP in aggregate across all claims under this Agreement. PARTY_A and PARTY_B acknowledge this limitation as a reasonable and agreed allocation of commercial risk. Effective EFFECTIVE_DATE, governed by GOVERNING_LAW.

types.description: Standard indemnification clause covering third-party IP claims and data breaches. Use for all SaaS and technology service agreements. Review with legal before applying to agreements with non-standard data handling terms.
types.clauseLanguage: PARTY_A shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless PARTY_B and its officers, directors, employees, and agents from and against any and all claims, damages, losses, costs, and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees) arising out of or relating to PARTY_A's material breach of this Agreement, gross negligence, or willful misconduct. PARTY_B shall promptly notify PARTY_A in writing of any such claim. This obligation survives termination and is governed by GOVERNING_LAW, effective as of EFFECTIVE_DATE.

types.description: Fallback indemnification for APAC region with narrowed scope per local regulatory constraints.
types.clauseLanguage: PARTY_A agrees to indemnify PARTY_B against all direct third-party claims, losses, and reasonable legal costs directly resulting from PARTY_A's material breach of this Agreement. The scope of indemnification under this clause is limited to direct damages only, in accordance with applicable local regulations. The indemnified party shall notify the indemnifying party in writing within NOTICE_PERIOD days of becoming aware of any such claim. This clause is subject to GOVERNING_LAW and effective from EFFECTIVE_DATE.
